objective: One native tangent directional audit at saved TRF terminal
directions: Actual last accepted TRF step and deterministic alternating retained direction; fixed machine-derived h and h/2; no retries
criterion: Same resolved native loading/hardening/positive-flow branch required. Pass only difference+estimated uncertainty <=1e-7*norm(A*d). Candidate defect only uncertainty<=threshold and difference-uncertainty>threshold. Otherwise unresolved. Diagnostic criterion only, no gate clearance.
uncertainty: Local consistency transport, central difference and 64eps floating estimates; engineering estimates, not certification
scope: No source/test/material/tolerance changes or nonlinear solves
provenance: Native TRF result and baseline/terminal/probes all bound and unchanged
